task: R5-HARNESS-01 — deterministic test infrastructure (temp sysroot ownership/isolation)

unbounded_temp_growth.evidence: 3467 abandoned %TEMP%\luna* directories / 21.3 GB across runs; runs aborted with `Os { code: 112, kind: StorageFull }` at support/stdlib.rs:34
unbounded_temp_growth.root_cause: suite-local helpers created unique temp sysroots with no owner: `ProviderModes` had only a heuristic Drop, and ~90 driver suites built paths from std::env::temp_dir() and never removed them

parallel_shared_output.evidence: full workspace run failed compiler_gap_c_gap_12_safe_loan_effect_tests with `build fresh canonical sysroot for artifact parity: "Build lock already exists"`; the same binary passed in isolation (4/4) and the single test passed alone (1/1)
parallel_shared_output.root_cause: suite helpers made paths unique with pid + SystemTime::now() only; Windows SystemTime granularity is coarse (~15 ms), so two tests running in parallel inside one binary produced the SAME directory, hence the same .build.lock and artifacts
parallel_shared_output.status: REPRODUCED + FIXED (owned_temp_root() now returns a unique child per call, so clock resolution cannot alias two tests)

primitives: TempWorkspace: RAII owner of a unique %TEMP% directory; removes it on Drop (including panic unwind). Removal is guarded structurally: name prefix `luna_test_ws_`, direct child of the process temp dir, and a marker file the type wrote.
owned_temp_root(): one owned root per test process for suite helpers that hand a PathBuf to existing call sites.
sweep_orphan_workspaces(): once-per-process reclamation of workspaces whose owning pid is no longer alive (covers process-lifetime sysroots and killed runs).
conversions: ProviderModes now owns a TempWorkspace (hand-rolled Drop and its path heuristic removed)
108 test files / 123 call sites switched from std::env::temp_dir() to the owned root; 6 unit-test sites in luna-driver/src likewise
explicitly_not_done: no compiler semantics, provider protocol or cache-invalidation change

guards.luna-test-support unit tests: drop removes workspace; panic unwind removes workspace; sequential workspaces do not accumulate; retain keeps for inspection; guard refuses to delete a foreign directory; sweep reclaims orphans but spares living/markerless dirs
guards.temp_workspace_lifecycle_cli (4 requeste: sequential ProviderModes::fresh() drops cleanly; dropped workspace leaves no sysroot; panic unwind cleans up; process temp root is owned+stable; parallel workspaces are distinct; a failing compile still leaves the workspace removable
guards.d1_fu2_completeness: already-diagnosed comptime failures are suppressed only while a visible error-level root diagnostic exists; otherwise the compiler fails closed (unit test + CLI matrix)

acceptance.mode: same parallel mode as the release gate (no --test-threads=1)
acceptance.residual: the single leftover directory is the last test process's workspace (0 bytes); the next process's orphan sweep reclaims it
acceptance.note: temp is measured as count and total size of %TEMP%\luna* before and after each full workspace run

verdict: R5-HARNESS-01: CLOSED / FIXED IN TESTED SCOPE (owned temp workspaces, no unbounded accumulation, per-test isolation preserved under parallel execution)
